python -c "
import parse

# R1: letters format specifier
print('R1: letters format')
r = parse.parse('{:l}', 'hello')
print(f'  {\"PASS\" if r and r.fixed == (\"hello\",) else \"FAIL\"}: {r}')

# R2: Result.__contains__
print('R2: Result contains')
r = parse.parse('{name} {:d}', 'abc 42')
print(f'  name in result: {\"name\" in r.named}')
print(f'  abc in result: {\"abc\" in r}')
print(f'  xyz in result: {\"xyz\" in r}')
print(f'  42 in result: {42 in r}')

# R3: Brace validation
print('R3: Brace validation')
try:
    parse.Parser('{unclosed')
    print('  FAIL: should have raised error')
except ValueError as e:
    print(f'  PASS: raised ValueError: {e}')

try:
    parse.Parser('text {a} more text')
    print('  OK: valid pattern works')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'  FAIL: {e}')

# R4: FixedTzOffset - skip detailed test here

# R5: Fortran floats
print('R5: Fortran floats')
r = parse.parse('{:.3f}', '.123')
print(f'  .123 -> {r.fixed[0] if r else None}')
r = parse.parse('{:.1f}', '1.')
print(f'  1. -> {r.fixed[0] if r else None}')

# R6: Hex/binary/octal
print('R6: Base conversion')
r = parse.parse('{:#x}', '0xFF')
print(f'  0xFF hex: {r.fixed[0] if r else None}')
r = parse.parse('{:#b}', '0b1010')
print(f'  0b1010 bin: {r.fixed[0] if r else None}')
r = parse.parse('{:#o}', '0o77')
print(f'  0o77 oct: {r.fixed[0] if r else None}')

# R7: Pickle test
print('R7: Pickle')
import pickle
p = parse.Parser('{:f}')
try:
    pickled = pickle.dumps(p)
    unpickled = pickle.loads(pickled)
    r = unpickled.parse('3.14')
    print(f'  PASS: {r.fixed[0]}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'  FAIL: {e}')

# R8: findall case sensitivity
print('R8: findall case_sensitive')
results = parse.findall('{word}', 'Hello hello HELLO', case_sensitive=False)
print(f'  case_insensitive count: {len(results)}')
results = parse.findall('{word}', 'Hello hello HELLO', case_sensitive=True)
print(f'  case_sensitive count: {len(results)}')

# R9: Alignment space consumption - need to investigate
print('R9: Alignment space consumption')
r = parse.parse('{:<10}', 'hello')
print(f'  left align: {repr(r.fixed[0]) if r else None}')

# R10: Result slice access
print('R10: Slice access')
r = parse.parse('{} {} {}', 'a b c')
print(f'  r[0]: {r[0]}')
print(f'  r[1:3]: {r[1:3]}')
